summary: Returns the value as a spreadsheet id, or throws.
description: At least 25 characters of letters, digits, hyphens and underscores — the id that sits in a spreadsheet URL between `/d/` and `/edit`. Nothing is fetched: the format is all that is checked.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, typed as a spreadsheet id.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the value is not a spreadsheet id.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireValidSpreadsheetId("1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"); // => "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"
requireValidSpreadsheetId("short-id"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidSpreadsheetId("has space in it and is long enough to pass"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
